messages:
support: Customer reports sudden 401s and increased p99 after a config push. Traffic intended for us-west-2 is landing in eu-west-1. customer request id r-4c7d. Observed ~2026-02-18 06:10 UTC.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: config apply by @maria at 2026-02-18T06:08:12Z — service=text-gen-prod, set failover.rotate_priority=true
maria: fyi i flipped rotate_priority for a canary experiment; i thought the selector was 'canary-*' but apparently the route name matched a wildcard and hit prod. rolling back now :grimacing:
diego: paste the route config and the exact route name please. need to inspect priority order, weights, and sticky flags
maria: live route excerpt:
```
route: "text-gen-prod"
failover_policy: mode: "priority"
rotate_priority: true
priority_array: ["eu-west-1","us-west-2","us-east-1"]
weights: ["50","30","20"]
sticky: true
sticky_ttl: 3600
```
samj: rotate_priority causes the controller to rotate the priority array every rotation_interval to spread load. if rotation happened right before sessions, sticky pinned to the new primary (eu-west) -> cross-region hits.
eva: repro i ran:
1) curl -i -H "X-Region: us-west-2" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood/v1/generate
2) after rotation, responses return `302` to `https://eu-west-1.api.redwood/…`
3) our tokens minted via us-west KMS validate `aud` for us-west; hitting eu-west returns `401` due to aud mismatch
support: customer impact: ~9m misrouting, p99 up ~130ms, ~14% 401s for auth flows, and ~$80 cross-region egress spike for their account. they escalated to support lead.
diego: immediate mitigations: 1) set rotate_priority=false on text-gen-prod and pin priority_array order, 2) set sticky_ttl=0 to disable session pinning while we reconcile, 3) rollback the canary patch, 4) run token revalidation plan w/ security if tokens TTLs overlap.
ops-bot: rollback executed by @maria at 2026-02-18T06:17:03Z — revert id d-20261 :white_check_mark:
maria: rollback confirmed and prod routing back to us-west. apologies, my selector was too broad. adding better guardrails.
samj: follow-ups: add controller lint rule to block rotate_priority=true for routes tagged `env:prod` unless explicitly allowlisted; emit an alert when rotation changes the top-priority region for >5% of traffic for a route; console UX: require explicit confirmation for rotate_priority on non-canary routes.
eva: i'll put together a minimal repro gist with curl + sample token headers and share in the ticket. will also add a KMS audit to check which tokens were accepted in eu-west during the window.
support: updating customer with timeline and mitigations (rollback done, sticky disabled temporarily). alerting finance about the egress delta.
diego: creating incident INC-2026-0245, assigning postmortem to me. action items: playbook entry "avoid rotating priority on prod routes", UX confirmation, controller lint, token revalidation runbook.
finance: please include egress delta and cost estimate in the incident doc — tagging billing to reconcile customer charges.
maria: sorry team. lesson learned on selectors. adding a canary-tooling PR to prevent wildcard matches.
support: customer acknowledged rollback and asked for an RCA doc. i'll draft and post in #support-postmortems. closing thread after RCA is shared.
